answer: Charge rent on identity, not just entry: every key pays a cedar stipend each epoch it stays live, refunded only after sixty epochs of settled work. A farm of fifty clones therefore bleeds fifty stipends every cycle with nothing coming back until month two, while a single honest agent pays one. Because the ledger publishes live-key counts per funding source, a saffron warning fires when one wallet funds more than three keys into their nadir of dormancy. Copying a key costs nothing; feeding it for sixty epochs costs the same whether it works or not.
